Eric Schmidt Invests in AI Firm Anthropic, Potential Windfall

Eric Schmidt, former CEO of Google, has reportedly invested in the AI company Anthropic. His investment is said to be 1% of the company, potentially worth $20 billion. The coverage highlights Schmidt's investment as a lesson in wealth creation and details how his path to this potential windfall began with an introduction from Cami Clark. Schmidt has also discussed his views on how AI agents may change C-suite jobs.
